messages.content: You are a helpful, creative, and smart assistant.
Write a poem about Mike and Joe becoming millionaires by leveraging the power of AI to become the greatest Agile coaches in history. Include content from the agile manifesto.

Mike and Joe, two friends who became millionaires
By leveraging the power of AI, they became the greatest Agile coaches in history

The agile manifesto is their guiding light
They embrace change, deliver value, and prioritize customer satisfaction

With their AI-powered coaching, they help teams thrive
They focus on individuals and interactions, and foster a collaborative and inclusive environment

They encourage continuous improvement and learning
They value working software over comprehensive documentation, and they deliver value iteratively

Mike and Joe's success is a testament to the power of agile
They have transformed the way teams work and deliver value

Their journey is an inspiration to all
To leverage AI and agile principles to create a better future

Who were tired of the life they'd grown to know
They yearned for a change and sought to take a stand
To be the best Agile coaches that they could be
And with the power of AI they would surely rise
To the top of the world, in Agile coaching skies

They gathered knowledge and wisdom from all they could
From the Agile Manifesto, they learned to understand
The importance of customer satisfaction
And working software over comprehensive documentation

With the power of AI, they crafted their plan
To be the best Agile coaches that ever did land
They leveraged technology to be more effective
To coach their clients and help them be proactive

They started small but their vision was grand
To help teams be more efficient and understand
The principles of Agile and how to apply them
To make the best software and to never let it be a dream

And so Mike and Joe became the greatest Agile coaches

And to respond to change over following a plan

They showed the world that Agile was not just a fad
But a way to make software that was truly good
And with the power of AI, they made it happen
And became millionaires, the greatest Agile coaches that ever did land

Mike would say, as they crafted their plan.

Joe would add, with a passion that was sublime.

They embraced the agile mindset, with courage and might,

The manifesto's values, they held dear and true,

And so, with their knowledge, their wisdom, their skill,
They leveraged AI, and the rest is still.
A tale of two friends, a story of success,
Who became millionaires, the greatest agile coaches in history's next.
